import datetime
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Set
import threading
import time
import uuid
import json

# =============================
# 1. Types and Constants
# =============================

# Types
TaskStatus = Enum("TaskStatus", ["PENDING", "IN_PROGRESS", "COMPLETED", "OVERDUE"])
PriorityLevel = Enum("PriorityLevel", ["LOW", "MEDIUM", "HIGH", "URGENT"])
ProjectPhase = Enum("ProjectPhase", ["PLANNING", "IN_PROGRESS", "REVIEW", "COMPLETED"])

# Constants
MAX_TEAM_SIZE = 100
MAX_TASKS_PER_PROJECT = 1000
REMINDER_THRESHOLD = 1  # Days before deadline for reminders
NOTIFICATION_TYPES = ["EMAIL", "IN_APP", "SMS"]

# =============================
# 2. Data Models
# =============================

@dataclass
class Task:
    task_id: str
    title: str
    description: str
    assignee: str
    start_time: datetime.datetime
    end_time: datetime.datetime
    priority: PriorityLevel
    status: TaskStatus
    project_id: str

@dataclass
class Project:
    project_id: str
    name: str
    description: str
    start_date: datetime.datetime
    end_date: datetime.datetime
    phase: ProjectPhase
    team_members: Set[str]
    tasks: List[Task]

@dataclass
class User:
    user_id: str
    name: str
    email: str
    role: str  # e.g., "DEVELOPER", "MANAGER"
    available_slots: List[datetime.datetime]

@dataclass
class Message:
    message_id: str
    sender_id: str
    receiver_id: str
    content: str
    timestamp: datetime.datetime

@dataclass
class Notification:
    notification_id: str
    user_id: str
    message: str
    timestamp: datetime.datetime
    type: str

# =============================
# 3. Application Logic
# =============================

class TeamSyncPro:
    def __init__(self):
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.projects: Dict[str, Project] = {}
        self.tasks: Dict[str, Task] = {}
        self.messages: List[Message] = []
        self.notifications: List[Notification] = []

    def add_user(self, name: str, email: str, role: str):
        user_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.users[user_id] = User(
            user_id=user_id,
            name=name,
            email=email,
            role=role,
            available_slots=[]
        )
        return user_id

    def add_project(self, name: str, description: str, start_date: datetime.datetime, end_date: datetime.datetime):
        project_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.projects[project_id] = Project(
            project_id=project_id,
            name=name,
            description=description,
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
            phase=ProjectPhase.PLANNING,
            team_members=set(),
            tasks=[]
        )
        return project_id

    def add_task(self, title: str, description: str, assignee_id: str, project_id: str, 
                 start_time: datetime.datetime, end_time: datetime.datetime, priority: PriorityLevel):
        task_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.tasks[task_id] = Task(
            task_id=task_id,
            title=title,
            description=description,
            assignee=assignee_id,
            start_time=start_time,
            end_time=end_time,
            priority=priority,
            status=TaskStatus.PENDING,
            project_id=project_id
        )
        self.projects[project_id].tasks.append(self.tasks[task_id])
        self._schedule_reminder(task_id)
        return task_id

    def send_message(self, sender_id: str, receiver_id: str, content: str):
        message_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.messages.append(Message(
            message_id=message_id,
            sender_id=sender_id,
            receiver_id=receiver_id,
            content=content,
            timestamp=datetime.datetime.now()
        ))

    def add_notification(self, user_id: str, message: str, notification_type: str):
        notification_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.notifications.append(Notification(
            notification_id=notification_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            message=message,
            timestamp=datetime.datetime.now(),
            type=notification_type
        ))

    def _schedule_reminder(self, task_id: str):
        task = self.tasks[task_id]
        time_until_task = (task.start_time - datetime.datetime.now()).total_seconds()
        if time_until_task > 0:
            threading.Timer(time_until_task, self._send_reminder, [task_id]).start()

    def _send_reminder(self, task_id: str):
        task = self.tasks[task_id]
        message = f"Reminder: Task '{task.title}' is starting at {task.start_time}"
        self.add_notification(task.assignee, message, "IN_APP")

    def generate_productivity_report(self, project_id: str):
        project = self.projects[project_id]
        report = {
            "project_id": project_id,
            "name": project.name,
            "start_date": project.start_date,
            "end_date": project.end_date,
            "phase": project.phase.name,
            "total_tasks": len(project.tasks),
            "completed_tasks": sum(1 for task in project.tasks if task.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED),
            "pending_tasks": sum(1 for task in project.tasks if task.status == TaskStatus.PENDING),
            "in_progress_tasks": sum(1 for task in project.tasks if task.status == TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS),
            "team_members": list(project.team_members),
            "task_summary": [
                {
                    "task_id": task.task_id,
                    "title": task.title,
                    "assignee": task.assignee,
                    "start_time": task.start_time,
                    "end_time": task.end_time,
                    "priority": task.priority.name,
                    "status": task.status.name
                }
                for task in project.tasks
            ]
        }
        return json.dumps(report, indent=2)

    def synchronize_schedules(self):
        for task_id, task in self.tasks.items():
            if task.status in [TaskStatus.PENDING, TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS] and task.end_time < datetime.datetime.now():
                task.status = TaskStatus.OVERDUE
        return True

    def adaptive_task_reassignment(self):
        for task_id, task in self.tasks.items():
            if task.status == TaskStatus.OVERDUE:
                user = self.users.get(task.assignee)
                if not user or not user.available_slots:
                    for user_id, user in self.users.items():
                        if user_id != task.assignee and user in self.projects[task.project_id].team_members:
                            task.assignee = user_id
                            break
        return True

# =============================
# 4. Main Execution
# =============================

def main():
    app = TeamSyncPro()

    # Example usage
    user1_id = app.add_user("Alice", "alice@example.com", "DEVELOPER")
    user2_id = app.add_user("Bob", "bob@example.com", "MANAGER")

    project1_id = app.add_project("Project Alpha", "Main development project", datetime.datetime.now(), datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(days=30))
    app.projects[project1_id].team_members = {user1_id, user2_id}

    task1_id = app.add_task("Design UI", "Design the user interface", user1_id, project1_id,
                            datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(days=2),
                            datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(days=5),
                            PriorityLevel.HIGH)

    task2_id = app.add_task("Backend API", "Develop API endpoints", user2_id, project1_id,
                            datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(days=3),
                            datetime.datetime.now() + datetime.timedelta(days=5),
                            PriorityLevel.MEDIUM)

    # Simulate messages
    app.send_message(user1_id, user2_id, "Can we align on the API structure?")
    app.send_message(user2_id, user1_id, "Sure! Let me share the design docs.")

    # Generate report
    report = app.generate_productivity_report(project1_id)
    print(report)

    # Synchronize schedules
    app.synchronize_schedules()

    # Adaptive Reassignment
    app.adaptive_task_reassignment()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class CollaborativeSchedulePlanner:

    def generate_initial_schedule(self):
        # Sort tasks by priority
        sorted_tasks = sorted(self.tasks, key=lambda x: x.priority.value, reverse=True)
        
        # Schedule each task
        for task in sorted_tasks:
            scheduled = False
            for user in self.users:
                # Simple scheduling logic: assign to first available user
                if self._can_schedule(task, user):
                    self._schedule_task(task, user)
                    scheduled = True
                    break
            if not scheduled:
                print(f"Could not schedule task {task.name}")

    def _can_schedule(self, task, user):
        # Check if the user has enough time to complete the task
        current_time = datetime.now()
        task_duration = timedelta(hours=task.duration)
        
        # For simplicity, assume we can schedule if there is at least task_duration of availability
        for date, times in user.availability.items():
            for start, end in times:
                if (end - start) >= task_duration:
                    return True
        return False

    def _schedule_task(self, task, user):
        # Simple scheduling (first available time slot)
        for date, times in user.availability.items():
            for start, end in times:
                task_start = start
                task_end = start + timedelta(hours=task.duration)
                if task_end <= end:
                    task.start_time = task_start
                    task.end_time = task_end
                    self.schedule.append((task, user, date))
                    break

        for task, user, date in self.schedule:

            labels.append(1)

        # Train the model

        if feedback:
            return sum(feedback) / len(feedback)

    """Main class for the CyberArena environment"""
    def __init__(self, width: float = 100, height: float = 100):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.teams = []  # list of teams in the arena
        self.robots = []  # list of all robots
        self.objectives = []  # list of objectives
        self.power_ups = []  # list of active power-ups
        self.hazards = []  # list of active hazards
        self.frame_rate = 60  # target frame rate
        self.game_time = 0.0  # total game time in seconds
        self.difficulty_level = 1  # adaptive difficulty level
    
    def add_team(self, team: Team):
        """Add a team to the arena"""
        self.teams.append(team)
        for robot in team.robots:
            self.robots.append(robot)
    
    def add_objective(self, objective: Objective):
        """Add an objective to the arena"""
        self.objectives.append(objective)
    
    def add_power_up(self, power_up: PowerUp, position: Tuple[float, float]):
        """Add a power-up to the arena"""
        self.power_ups.append({
            "power_up": power_up,
            "position": np.array(position),
            "active": True
        })
    
    def add_hazard(self, hazard: EnvironmentalHazard, position: Tuple[float, float]):
        """Add an environmental hazard to the arena"""
        self.hazards.append({
            "hazard": hazard,
            "position": np.array(position),
            "active": True
        })
    
    def update(self):
        """Update the entire arena state"""
        # Update all robots
        for team in self.teams:
            team.update_team(self)
        
        # Update all objectives
        for objective in self.objectives:
            objective.update(self)
        
        # Update power-ups
        for power_up in self.power_ups:
            if power_up["active"]:
                # Check if any robot is near the power-up
                for robot in self.robots:
                    if np.linalg.norm(robot.position - power_up["position"]) < 2.0:
                        robot.power_ups.append(power_up["power_up"])
                        power_up["active"] = False
                        print(f"{robot.name} picked up a {power_up['power_up'].name} power-up!")
        
        # Update hazards
        for hazard in self.hazards:
            if hazard["active"]:
                # Check if any robot is in the hazard area
                for robot in self.robots:
                    if np.linalg.norm(robot.position - hazard["position"]) < hazard["hazard"].radius:
                        robot.hazards.append(hazard["hazard"])
                        print(f"{robot.name} entered a {hazard['hazard'].name} hazard!")
        
        # Update game time
        self.game_time += 1.0 / self.frame_rate
        
        # Adaptive difficulty system
        self.update_difficulty()
        
        # Team score updates
        for team in self.teams:
            team.calculate_score()
    
    def update_difficulty(self):
        """Adjust difficulty based on current game state"""
        total_health = sum(robot.health for team in self.teams for robot in team.robots)
        average_health = total_health / len(self.robots) if self.robots else 0
        
        # If robots are doing well, increase difficulty
        if average_health > 80 and self.difficulty_level < 5:
            self.difficulty_level += 1
            print(f"Difficulty increased to level {self.difficulty_level}")
            # Make enemies more aggressive and powerful
            for team in self.teams:
                if team.name != "player_team":
                    for robot in team.robots:
                        robot.speed += 0.2
                        for weapon in robot.weapons:
                            weapon.damage += 5
        
        # If robots are struggling, decrease difficulty
        elif average_health < 40 and self.difficulty_level > 1:
            self.difficulty_level -= 1
            print(f"Difficulty decreased to level {self.difficulty_level}")
            # Make enemies less aggressive and powerful
            for team in self.teams:
                if team.name != "player_team":
                    for robot in team.robots:
                        robot.speed = max(1.0, robot.speed - 0.2)
                        for weapon in robot.weapons:
                            weapon.damage = max(5, weapon.damage - 5)
    
    def run(self, duration: float):
        """Run the arena simulation for a specified duration"""
        start_time = time.time()
        while time.time() - start_time < duration:
            # Calculate frame start time
            frame_start = time.time()
            
            # Update arena
            self.update()
            
            # Calculate frame duration and sleep if needed
            frame_duration = time.time() - frame_start
            if frame_duration < 1.0 / self.frame_rate:
                time.sleep(1.0 / self.frame_rate - frame_duration)
    
    def display_status(self):
        """Display current game status"""
        print(f"\n=== CyberArena Status ===")
        print(f"Time: {self.game_time:.1f} seconds")
        print(f"Difficulty: Level {self.difficulty_level}")
        
        for team in self.teams:
            print(f"\nTeam {team.name}:")
            print(f"  Score: {team.score}")
            print(f"  Robots: {len(team.robots)}")
            for robot in team.robots:
                print(f"    - {robot.name} (HP: {robot.health:.1f}/{robot.max_health})")
        
        for objective in self.objectives:
            print(f"\nObjective {objective.name}: {objective.status}")
            if hasattr(objective, "flag_position"):
                print(f"  Flag Position: {objective.flag_position}")
            if hasattr(objective, "base_health"):
                print(f"  Base Health: {objective.base_health}")
        
        print("\n")

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from enum import Enum
import pygame
import numpy as np
from pygame.locals import *
from typing import List, Tuple, Dict, Set, Optional

# Base classes
class Direction(Enum):
    """
    Enum for 2D movement directions
    """
    UP = (0, -1)
    DOWN = (0, 1)
    LEFT = (-1, 0)
    RIGHT = (1, 0)

    def get_vector(self):
        """
        Return the direction vector
        """
        return pygame.math.Vector2(*self.value)


class Position:
    """
    Position class with x and y coordinates
    """
    def __init__(self, x: float, y: float):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def to_tuple(self) -> Tuple[float, float]:
        """
        Convert position to tuple
        """
        return (self.x, self.y)


class CelestialBody:
    """
    Represents a celestial body with basic properties
    """
    def __init__(self, name: str, mass: float, radius: float, position: Position, velocity: Tuple[float, float]):
        self.name = name
        self.mass = mass
        self.radius = radius
        self.position = position
        self.velocity = np.array(velocity)

    def update_position(self, delta_time: float):
        """
        Update the body's position based on velocity and time step
        """
        self.position.x += self.velocity[0] * delta_time
        self.position.y += self.velocity[1] * delta_time


class SimulationEngine:
    """
    Handles the simulation of gravitational interactions and orbital dynamics
    """
    def __init__(self, bodies: List[CelestialBody]):
        self.bodies = bodies

    def calculate_gravitational_forces(self):
        """
        Simulate gravitational interactions between celestial bodies
        """
        G = 6.67430e-11  # gravitational constant
        for i, body in enumerate(self.bodies):
            acceleration = np.array([0.0, 0.0])
            for j, other in enumerate(self.bodies):
                if i != j:
                    dx = other.position.x - body.position.x
                    dy = other.position.y - body.position.y
                    distance_squared = dx**2 + dy**2
                    distance = np.sqrt(distance_squared)
                    if distance > 0:
                        force = (G * body.mass * other.mass) / distance_squared
                        ax = force * dx / distance / body.mass
                        ay = force * dy / distance / body.mass
                        acceleration += np.array([ax, ay])
            body.velocity += acceleration

    def step(self, delta_time: float):
        """
        Perform a simulation step
        """
        self.calculate_gravitational_forces()
        for body in self.bodies:
            body.update_position(delta_time)


class Visualization:
    """
    Handles the 3D rendering and interactivity of the simulation
    """
    def __init__(self, width: int, height: int):
        pygame.init()
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((width, height), DOUBLEBUF | OPENGL)
        self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
        self.running = True

    def render(self, bodies: List[CelestialBody]):
        """
        Render the current simulation state
        """
        self.screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
        for body in bodies:
            pygame.draw.circle(self.screen, (255, 255, 255), 
                               (int(body.position.x), int(body.position.y)), 
                               int(body.radius))
        pygame.display.flip()

    def handle_events(self):
        """
        Handle user input and events
        """
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == QUIT:
                self.running = False

    def run(self, simulation: SimulationEngine, delta_time: float = 0.01):
        """
        Run the simulation with visualization
        """
        while self.running:
            self.handle_events()
            simulation.step(delta_time)
            self.render(simulation.bodies)
            self.clock.tick(60)


class EducationalContent:

    def __init__(self):

            "orbital_mechanics": "Orbital motion occurs due to the balance between gravitational pull and inertia.",

        }

    def show_fact(self, topic: str):

        if topic in self.facts:

# solution.py

import socket
import threading
import time
from enum import Enum
import json
import os
import logging
from collections import deque
import random
import psutil
import signal
import sys

# file_name_1.py
# NetworkGuard - Real-time Network Security Monitoring System

# Configuration constants
LOG_FILE = "networkguard.log"
MAX_LOG_ENTRIES = 10000
THRESHOLD_PACKET_SIZE = 1500  # bytes
THRESHOLD_PACKET_VOLUME = 1000  # packets per second
THRESHOLD_SUSPICIOUS_PORT = [21, 23, 25, 135, 3389]  # FTP, Telnet, SMTP, SMB, RDP
MALWARE_SIGNATURES = ["malware_sig_1", "malware_sig_2", "malware_sig_3"]

# Log setup
logging.basicConfig(filename=LOG_FILE, level=logging.INFO, format='%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s')

# Enums
class AlertLevel(Enum):
    LOW = 1
    MEDIUM = 2
    HIGH = 3

class AlertType(Enum):
    UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS = 1
    LARGE_DATA_TRANSFER = 2
    MALWARE_DETECTED = 3
    PORT_SCAN_DETECTED = 4
    HIGH_TRAFFIC_VOLUME = 5
    UNKNOWN = 6

# NetworkGuard classes
class NetworkInterfaceMonitor:
    def __init__(self):
        self.interface = None
        self.running = False
        self.packet_queue = deque()
        self.packet_rate_window = deque()
        self.packet_rate_window_size = 1  # seconds
        self.packet_rate_threshold = THRESHOLD_PACKET_VOLUME

    def start_monitor(self, interface="eth0"):
        self.interface = interface
        self.running = True
        logging.info(f"Starting network monitoring on interface: {interface}")
        monitor_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._monitor_packets)
        monitor_thread.start()

    def stop_monitor(self):
        self.running = False
        logging.info("Stopping network monitor.")

    def _monitor_packets(self):
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_PACKET, socket.SOCK_RAW, socket.htons(3))
        sock.bind((self.interface, 0))
        while self.running:
            packet = sock.recv(65535)
            self._process_packet(packet)

    def _process_packet(self, packet):
        packet_size = len(packet)
        src_ip = self._extract_ip(packet)
        dst_ip = self._extract_ip(packet, src=False)
        dst_port = self._extract_port(packet)

        # Log packet
        log_entry = {
            "timestamp": time.time(),
            "src_ip": src_ip,
            "dst_ip": dst_ip,
            "dst_port": dst_port,
            "packet_size": packet_size
        }
        self.packet_queue.append(log_entry)

        # Check for suspicious activities
        self._check_for_suspicious_activity(src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, packet_size)

        # Maintain rolling packet rate
        self._update_packet_rate(packet_size)

    def _extract_ip(self, packet, src=True):
        # Simplified IP extraction for demonstration
        ip_header = packet[14:34]
        if src:
            return f"{ip_header[12]}.{ip_header[13]}.{ip_header[14]}.{ip_header[15]}"
        else:
            return f"{ip_header[16]}.{ip_header[17]}.{ip_header[18]}.{ip_header[19]}"

    def _extract_port(self, packet):
        # Simplified port extraction for TCP
        tcp_header = packet[34:54]
        return int(tcp_header[20:22].hex(), 16)

    def _check_for_suspicious_activity(self, src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port, packet_size):
        # Check for suspicious ports
        if dst_port in THRESHOLD_SUSPICIOUS_PORT:
            self._trigger_alert(
                AlertLevel.MEDIUM,
                AlertType.PORT_SCAN_DETECTED,
                f"Port scan detected on port {dst_port} from {src_ip} to {dst_ip}"
            )

        # Check for unusual data transfer
        if packet_size > THRESHOLD_PACKET_SIZE:
            self._trigger_alert(
                AlertLevel.LOW,
                AlertType.LARGE_DATA_TRANSFER,
                f"Large packet detected: {packet_size} bytes from {src_ip} to {dst_ip}"
            )

        # Check for malware signatures (simulated)
        if random.random() < 0.001:
            self._trigger_alert(
                AlertLevel.HIGH,
                AlertType.MALWARE_DETECTED,
                f"Malware signature detected in packet from {src_ip} to {dst_ip}"
            )

    def _update_packet_rate(self, packet_size):
        current_time = time.time()
        # Remove packets older than window size
        while self.packet_rate_window and self.packet_rate_window[0]["timestamp"] < current_time - self.packet_rate_window_size:
            self.packet_rate_window.popleft()
        # Add new packet
        self.packet_rate_window.append({"timestamp": current_time, "size": packet_size})
        # Check for high traffic
        if len(self.packet_rate_window) > self.packet_rate_threshold:
            self._trigger_alert(
                AlertLevel.MEDIUM,
                AlertType.HIGH_TRAFFIC_VOLUME,
                f"High traffic volume detected: {len(self.packet_rate_window)} packets in {self.packet_rate_window_size} second(s)"
            )

    def _trigger_alert(self, level, alert_type, message):
        log_entry = {
            "alert_level": level.name,
            "alert_type": alert_type.name,
            "message": message,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        }
        logging.warning(json.dumps(log_entry))
        print(f"[ALERT] {message}")

class ThreatAnalyzer:
    def __init__(self):
        self.patterns = self.load_patterns()

        }

        # Load known benign traffic patterns to avoid false positives
        return {
            'benign_signature_1': b'\x00\x00\x00\x00',
            'benign_signature_2': b'\x11\x22\x33\x00',
        }

    def analyze_packet(self, packet_data: bytes, source_ip: str, dest_ip: str) -> Dict:
        self.packet_count += 1
        
        # Check for benign signatures first
        for sig_name, sig_pattern in self.benign_signatures.items():
            if sig_pattern in packet_data:
                return {
                    'threat_type': ThreatType.UNKNOWN.value,
                    'source_ip': source_ip,
                    'dest_ip': dest_ip,
                    'details': f"Benign traffic identified ({sig_name})"
                }

        # Check for malicious signatures
        for pattern_name, pattern in self.patterns.items():
            if pattern in packet_data:
                threat_type = self.map_pattern_to_threat(pattern_name)
                return {
                    'threat_type': threat_type,
                    'source_ip': source_ip,
                    'dest_ip': dest_ip,
                    'details': f"{threat_type} detected via pattern {pattern_name}"
                }

        # Fallback unknown classification
        return {
            'threat_type': ThreatType.UNKNOWN.value,
            'source_ip': source_ip,
            'dest_ip': dest_ip,
            'details': 'No known threat signature matched.'
        }

    def map_pattern_to_threat(self, pattern_name: str) -> str:
        if 'malware' in pattern_name:
            return ThreatType.MALWARE.value
        elif 'phishing' in pattern_name:
            return ThreatType.PHISHING.value
        elif 'unauthorized' in pattern_name:
            return ThreatType.UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS.value
        elif 'encrypted_malicious' in pattern_name:
            return ThreatType.ENCRYPTED_MALICIOUS_TRAFFIC.value

Please write a collaborative game development framework called Multi-Agent Shooter Framework (MASF). MASF is a comprehensive system that enables multiple AI agents to work together in developing and enhancing a shooter game, focusing on both the frontend and backend aspects of the game.    - The frontend domain should be responsible for designing and implementing the user interface, including the game screen, scoreboards, and menus. The frontend should be developed using modern web technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, and should be responsive to various screen sizes.

   - The system should support real-time communication between the frontend and backend using WebSockets to ensure that game events and updates are synchronized across all connected clients.    - The Multi-Agent Shooter Framework should include a collaboration layer that allows multiple AI agents to contribute to the game's development.     def __init__(self, name: str, weapon_type: WeaponType, power: float, cooldown: float):
        self.name = name
        self.weapon_type = weapon_type
        self.power = power
        self.cooldown = cooldown
        self.remaining_cooldown = 0.0

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        """Check if the weapon is ready to be used."""
        return self.remaining_cooldown <= 0.0

    def use(self):
        """Use the weapon and start the cooldown period."""
        self.remaining_cooldown = self.cooldown

    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update the weapon's cooldown timer."""
        if self.remaining_cooldown > 0:
            self.remaining_cooldown = max(0.0, self.remaining_cooldown - delta_time)

        direction = np.array(target_position) - self.position
        distance = np.linalg.norm(direction)
        if distance > 0:
            direction = direction / distance
            self.position += direction * speed * self.speed_multiplier * delta_time

        self.objective_type = objective_type
        self.position = np.array(position)
        self.is_complete = False

    def update(self, arena: "CyberArena"):
        """Update the objective's state based on the arena."""
        # Implement specific logic based on objective type
        if self.objective_type == ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG:
            # Check if any robot has captured the flag
            for robot in arena.robots:
                if np.linalg.norm(robot.position - self.position) < 2:
                    self.is_complete = True
                    robot.score += 100
                    print(f"{robot.name} has captured the flag!")
        elif self.objective_type == ObjectiveType.DEFEND_BASE:
            # Check if the base is under attack
            base_position = (20, 0, 20) if self.team == Team.RED else (80, 0, 80)
            for robot in arena.robots:
                if robot.team != self.team and np.linalg.norm(robot.position - base_position) < 5:
                    # Base is under attack, penalize defending team
                    self.is_complete = False
                    for defender in [r for r in arena.robots if r.team == self.team]:
                        defender.score -= 20
        elif self.objective_type == ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD:
            # Check if the payload has reached the destination
            if hasattr(arena, "payload") and arena.payload.is_reached:
                self.is_complete = True
                for robot in arena.robots:
                    if robot.team == arena.payload.team:
                        robot.score += 150

class Payload:
    """Class representing a payload that needs to be escorted to a destination."""
    
    def __init__(self, team: Team, start_position: Tuple[float, float, float], destination: Tuple[float, float, float]):
        self.team = team
        self.position = np.array(start_position)
        self.destination = np.array(destination)
        self.is_reached = False
        self.speed = 1.0

    def update(self, delta_time: float, arena: "CyberArena"):
        """Update the payload's position and check if it has reached the destination."""
        if not self.is_reached:
            direction = self.destination - self.position
            distance = np.linalg.norm(direction)
            if distance > 0:
                direction = direction / distance
                self.position += direction * self.speed * delta_time
                if np.linalg.norm(self.position - self.destination) < 1.0:
                    self.is_reached = True
                    print(f"{self.team.value}'s payload has reached the destination!")

        self.position = np.array(position)
        self.radius = radius

    def check_collision(self, robot: Robot):
        """Check if a robot has collided with this hazard and apply damage."""
        distance = np.linalg.norm(robot.position - self.position)
        if distance <= self.radius:
            if self.hazard_type == HazardType.LAVA:
                robot.take_damage(5.0)
            elif self.hazard_type == HazardType.ELECTRIC_FIELD:
                robot.take_damage(3.0)
                for weapon in robot.weapons:
                    weapon.remaining_cooldown = max(0, weapon.remaining_cooldown - 0.5)
            elif self.hazard_type == HazardType.ACID_SPRAY:
                robot.take_damage(2.0)
                robot.speed_multiplier = max(0.5, robot.speed_multiplier - 0.1)

import time
import math
from enum import Enum
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

# Define constants for the simulation
SCREEN_WIDTH = 800
SCREEN_HEIGHT = 600
MAX_HEALTH = 100
MAX_ENERGY = 100
MAX_SPEED = 5
MAX_WEAPON_DAMAGE = 20
BASE_DIFFICULTY = 1.0
DIFFICULTY_ADJUSTMENT_RATE = 0.1
LEARNING_RATE = 0.05
POWER_UP_SPAWN_RATE = 0.05  # chance per second for power-up to spawn
HAZARD_SPAWN_RATE = 0.03    # chance per second for hazard to spawn

# Define types for game elements
class Team(Enum):
    RED = 1
    BLUE = 2
    NEUTRAL = 3

class WeaponType(Enum):
    LASER = 1
    PLASMA = 2
    MELEE = 3

class ObjectiveType(Enum):
    CAPTURE_FLAG = 1
    DEFEND_BASE = 2
    ESCORT_PAYLOAD = 3

class ActionType(Enum):
    MOVE_FORWARD = 1
    MOVE_BACKWARD = 2
    TURN_LEFT = 3
    TURN_RIGHT = 4
    SHOOT = 5

# Abstract base class for game entities
class GameEntity(ABC):
    def __init__(self, x, y, health=MAX_HEALTH, energy=MAX_ENERGY):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.health = health
        self.energy = energy

    @abstractmethod
    def update(self, delta_time):
        pass

    def take_damage(self, amount):
        self.health = max(0, self.health - amount)
        if self.health == 0:
            self.on_death()

    def on_death(self):
        pass

# Player class
class Player(GameEntity):
    def __init__(self, x, y, team, speed=MAX_SPEED):
        super().__init__(x, y)
        self.team = team
        self.speed = speed

    def update(self, delta_time):
        pass

    def shoot(self, weapon_type):
        if self.energy >= 10:
            self.energy -= 10
            damage = random.randint(5, MAX_WEAPON_DAMAGE)
            print(f"{self.team.name} player shot with {weapon_type.name} for {damage} damage.")

# Enemy class
class Enemy(GameEntity):
    def __init__(self, x, y, difficulty):
        super().__init__(x, y)
        self.difficulty = difficulty

    def update(self, delta_time):
        pass

    def on_death(self):
        print("Enemy defeated.")

# Objective class
class Objective:
    def __init__(self, x, y, objective_type):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.objective_type = objective_type

# Power-up class
class PowerUp:
    def __init__(self, x, y, power_type):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.power_type = power_type

# Game Manager class to handle game logic
class GameManager:
    def __init__(self, width=SCREEN_WIDTH, height=SCREEN_HEIGHT):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.players = []
        self.enemies = []
        self.objectives = []
        self.power_ups = []

    def add_player(self, player):
        self.players.append(player)

    def add_enemy(self, enemy):
        self.enemies.append(enemy)

    def add_objective(self, objective):
        self.objectives.append(objective)

    def add_power_up(self, power_up):
        self.power_ups.append(power_up)

    def update(self, delta_time):
        for player in self.players:
            player.update(delta_time)

        for enemy in self.enemies:
            enemy.update(delta_time)

        # Spawn power-ups based on spawn rate
        if random.random() < POWER_UP_SPAWN_RATE * delta_time:
            power_type = random.choice(["HEAL", "SPEED", "SHIELD"])
            x = random.randint(0, self.width)
            y = random.randint(0, self.height)
            self.add_power_up(PowerUp(x, y, power_type))

        # Spawn hazards based on spawn rate
        if random.random() < HAZARD_SPAWN_RATE * delta_time:
            x = random.randint(0, self.width)
            y = random.randint(0, self.height)
            print(f"Hazard spawned at ({x}, {y})")

# Main game loop
if __name__ == "__main__":
    game = GameManager()

    # Add players
    game.add_player(Player(100, 100, Team.RED))
    game.add_player(Player(700, 500, Team.BLUE))

    # Add enemies
    game.add_enemy(Enemy(400, 300, 1.5))

    # Add objectives
    game.add_objective(Objective(400, 100, ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG))

    # Run game loop
    running = True
    last_time = time.time()
    while running:
        current_time = time.time()
        delta_time = current_time - last_time
        last_time = current_time

        game.update(delta_time)

        # Check for quit condition (in a real game, this would be based on user input)
        if random.random() < 0.001:  # 0.1% chance per frame to end the game
            running = False

    print("Game ended.")"
}

        elif self.robot_type == RobotType.ASSASSIN:

        # Define the robot's available skills based on its type
        if self.robot_type == RobotType.TANK:

        elif self.robot_type == RobotType.SCOUT:
            return ["Stealth", "Rapid Fire", "Recon Scan"]
        elif self.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
            return ["Heal", "Buff", "Teleport"]
        elif self.robot_type == RobotType.ASSASSIN:
            return ["Backstab", "Cloak", "Smoke Bomb"]

    def determine_strategy(self):

        if self.role == "Defender":

        elif self.role == "Recon":

        elif self.role == "Medic":
            return "Heal allies and support the team"
        elif self.role == "Attacker":
            return "Eliminate high-value targets"

    def take_damage(self, damage):
        # Apply damage to the robot, considering defense
        actual_damage = max(0, damage - self.defense)

        return actual_damage

            self.weapon_cooldown = self.weapon.cooldown
            return damage
        return 0

        elif self.strategy == "Scout the battlefield and gather intel":

        elif self.strategy == "Heal allies and support the team":

            target = self.find_high_value_target(arena)
            if target:

        return None

# Class representing a power-up
class PowerUp:
    def __init__(self, power_up_type, position, duration=10):
        self.type = power_up_type
        self.position = position
        self.is_active = True
        self.duration = duration
        self.timer = duration

    def apply_effect(self):
        # Apply the power-up's effect to robots in the area
        for robot in arena.robots:
            if self.is_robot_in_range(robot):
                self.apply_power_up(robot)
                self.timer -= 1
                if self.timer <= 0:
                    self.is_active = False

    def is_robot_in_range(self, robot):
        # Check if a robot is within the power-up's range
        distance = arena.calculate_distance(robot.position, self.position)
        return distance <= 5  # Power-up range

    def apply_power_up(self, robot):
        # Apply the specific power-up effect
        if self.type == PowerUpType.HEAL:
            robot.heal(20)
            print(f"{robot.name} uses a Heal power-up and regains 20 health!")
        elif self.type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
            robot.speed = min(2.0, robot.speed * 1.5)
            print(f"{robot.name} uses a Speed Boost power-up and increases speed!")
        elif self.type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:
            robot.damage = min(30, robot.damage * 1.5)
            print(f"{robot.name} uses a Damage Boost power-up and increases attack power!")
        elif self.type == PowerUpType.SHIELD_BOOST:
            robot.defense += 10
            print(f"{robot.name} uses a Shield Boost power-up and gains 10 defense!")

    def respawn(self):
        # Respawn the power-up at a random position
        self.position = arena.random_position(arena.play_area)
        self.is_active = True
        self.timer = self.duration

        self.position = position
        self.is_active = True
        self.damage_per_tick = damage_per_tick
        self.duration = duration
        self.timer = duration

        # Apply the hazard's effect to robots in the area
        for robot in arena.robots:
            if self.is_robot_in_range(robot):

                if self.timer <= 0:

        distance = arena.calculate_distance(robot.position, self.position)

    def respawn(self):
        # Respawn the hazard at a random position
        self.position = arena.random_position(arena.play_area)
        self.is_active = True
        self.timer = self.duration

            WeaponType.ICE_CANNON: 12,
            WeaponType.GRENADE_LAUNCHER: 22
        }
        
        base_damage = damage_multipliers.get(self.weapon, 10)

import random

import math

from enum import Enum

class Direction(Enum):
    UP = 1
    DOWN = 2
    LEFT = 3
    RIGHT = 4
    IDLE = 5

class ActionType(Enum):
    ATTACK = 1
    MOVE = 2
    USE_ABILITY = 3
    GATHER_INFO = 4

class WeaponType(Enum):
    RANGED = 1
    MELEE = 2
    SUPPORT = 3

class Team(Enum):
    RED = 1
    BLUE = 2
    NEUTRAL = 3

class Robot:
    def __init__(self, name, team, position=(0, 0)):
        self.name = name
        self.team = team
        self.position = position
        self.health = 100
        self.max_health = 100
        self.attack_power = 10
        self.defense = 5
        self.speed = 5
        self.weapon = None
        self.abilities = []
        self.score = 0
        self.experience = 0
        self.strategy = "standard"
        self.memory = []  # Stores past actions and outcomes

    def move(self, direction):
        """Move the robot in the specified direction."""
        x, y = self.position
        if direction == Direction.UP:
            y -= self.speed
        elif direction == Direction.DOWN:
            y += self.speed
        elif direction == Direction.LEFT:
            x -= self.speed
        elif direction == Direction.RIGHT:
            x += self.speed
        self.position = (x, y)

    def attack(self, target):
        """Attack another robot with current weapon."""
        if self.weapon and self.weapon.weapon_type == WeaponType.RANGED:
            if self.is_in_range(target):
                damage = max(0, self.attack_power - target.defense)
                target.take_damage(damage)
                self.memory.append({"action": "attack", "target": target.name, "damage": damage, "success": True})
                return True
        elif self.weapon and self.weapon.weapon_type == WeaponType.MELEE:
            if self.is_in_melee_range(target):
                damage = max(0, self.attack_power - target.defense)
                target.take_damage(damage)

    """Main class for the CyberArena simulation"""
    
    def __init__(self, width: float, height: float, num_teams: int = 4):
        # Create environment
        self.arena = Environment(width, height)
        
        # Create teams and robots
        self.teams: List[TeamAI] = []
        self.robots: List[Robot] = []
        
        # Create a team for each color
        for i, team in enumerate(list(Team)):
            if i < num_teams:

                team_robots = [
                    Robot(f"Robot{i*5+j+1}", team, 
                          RobotRole((j % 5) + 1),  # Cycle through roles
                          Position(random.uniform(0, width), random.uniform(0, height)))
                    for j in range(5)
                ]
                self.robots.extend(team_robots)
                self.teams.append(TeamAI(team, team_robots))
            else:
                break
        
        # Set up initial objectives
        self.objectives: List[Objective] = [
            Objective(ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG, Position(40, 60)),
            Objective(ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD, Position(10, 10), Position(90, 90)),
            Objective(ObjectiveType.DESTROY_TARGET, Position(70, 30))
        ]
        
        # Set up power-ups
        for _ in range(5):
            power_up_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
            duration = random.uniform(5, 15)
            x = random.uniform(0, width)
            y = random.uniform(0, height)
            self.arena.power_ups.append(PowerUp(power_up_type, duration))
    
    def run(self, duration: float):
        """Run the simulation for a given duration"""
        start_time = time.time()
        last_update = start_time
        
        while time.time() - start_time < duration:
            current_time = time.time()
            delta_time = current_time - last_update
            last_update = current_time
            
            # Update all teams
            for team_ai in self.teams:
                team_ai.update(self.arena, delta_time)
            
            # Update environment
            self.arena.update(delta_time)
            
            # Update objectives
            for objective in self.objectives:
                objective.update(self.robots)
            
            # Display status
            self.display_status()
            
            # Wait for next frame
            time.sleep(0.1)  # Simulate real-time updates
        
        # End of simulation
        self.display_final_results()
    
    def display_status(self):
        """Display current status of the simulation"""
        print("\n=== CyberArena Status ===")
        for team_ai in self.teams:
            print(f"Team {team_ai.team}: {team_ai.team.team_score} points")
            for robot in team_ai.robots:
                print(f"  {robot.name}: {robot.health} HP, at position ({robot.position.x}, {robot.position.y})")
        
        print("\nObjectives:")
        for i, objective in enumerate(self.objectives):
            print(f"  Objective {i+1}: {objective.objective_type.name}, Progress: {objective.get_progress() * 100:.1f}%")
    
    def display_final_results(self):
        """Display final results of the simulation"""
        print("\n=== Final Results ===")
        for team_ai in self.teams:
            print(f"Team {team_ai.team}: {team_ai.team.team_score} points")
            for robot in team_ai.robots:
                print(f"  {robot.name}: {robot.health} HP")
                if robot.health < 100:

                else:

        # Have teams learn from this battle
        for team_ai in self.teams:
            team_ai.learn_from_battle()

        """Add a hazard to the arena"""
        self.hazards.append(hazard)

        self.difficulty = min(2.0, self.difficulty + 0.1)
        self._adjust_ai_behavior("increase")
        
    def decrease_difficulty(self):
        """Decrease the difficulty level of the arena"""
        self.difficulty = max(0.5, self.difficulty - 0.1)
        self._adjust_ai_behavior("decrease")
        
    def _adjust_ai_behavior(self, direction: str):
        """Adjust the AI behavior based on the difficulty change"""
        for robot in self.robots:
            if direction == "increase":
                # Make robots more aggressive
                robot.velocity.x *= 1.1
                robot.velocity.y *= 1.1
            else:
                # Make robots less aggressive
                robot.velocity.x *= 0.9
                robot.velocity.y *= 0.9
                
    def update(self, time_delta: float):
        """Update the entire arena - main simulation loop"""
        self.current_time += time_delta
        
        # Update all robots
        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.is_alive():
                robot.update(self.current_time, self)
                robot.update_position(time_delta)
                
                # Check if robot is in a hazard
                for hazard in self.hazards:
                    if self.distance(robot.position, hazard.position) < hazard.radius:
                        robot.take_damage(int(hazard.damage_per_second * time_delta))
                        
                # Check if robot picked up a power-up
                active_power_ups = [pu for pu in self.power_ups if pu.active]
                for power_up in active_power_ups:
                    if self.distance(robot.position, power_up.position) < 1.0:
                        robot.apply_power_up(power_up)
                        power_up.active = False

        for power_up in self.power_ups:
            if power_up.active and self.current_time > power_up.duration:
                power_up.active = False
                
    def distance(self, pos1: Position, pos2: Position) -> float:
        """Calculate distance between two positions"""
        return ((pos1.x - pos2.x)**2 + (pos1.y - pos2.y)**2 + (pos1.z - pos2.z)**2)**0.5

            self.equipped_weapon_index = 1

        """Switch to an offensive strategy"""

        if len(self.weapons) > 1 and self.weapons[1].damage > self.weapons[0].damage:

        """Implement tank-specific behavior"""

            objective_pos = objectives["base"]["position"]
            # Move towards the objective position
            self.velocity.x = (objective_pos.x - self.position.x) * 0.1
            self.velocity.y = (objective_pos.y - self.position.y) * 0.1

        if enemies:
            closest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: self.distance_to(e))
            if self.distance_to(closest_enemy) < self.get_equipped_weapon().range:
                if self.get_equipped_weapon().is_ready(current_time):
                    self.attack(closest_enemy, current_time)

            else:
                # Move towards the enemy

                self.velocity.y = (closest_enemy.position.y - self.position.y) * 0.2

        """Implement support-specific behavior"""
        # Heal teammates
        teammates = [robot for robot in objectives["team"] if robot.team == self.team]
        if teammates:

                lowest_health_teammate.heal(5)  # Heal for 5 points

        if "heal" in self.abilities and current_time - self.abilities["heal"] >= 10.0:

            self.abilities["heal"] = current_time

                robot.velocity.y *= 1.1
            else:
                # Make robots less aggressive
                robot.velocity.x *= 0.9
                robot.velocity.y *= 0.9

        """Update the entire arena - main simulation loop"""
        self.current_time += time_delta
        
        # Update all robots
        for robot in self.robots:
            if robot.is_alive():
                robot.update(self.current_time, self)
                robot.update_position(time_delta)
                
                # Check if robot is in a hazard
                for hazard in self.hazards:
                    if self.distance(robot.position, hazard.position) < hazard.radius:
                        robot.take_damage(int(hazard.damage_per_second * time_delta))
                        
                # Check if robot picked up a power-up
                active_power_ups = [pu for pu in self.power_ups if pu.active]
                for power_up in active_power_ups:
                    if self.distance(robot.position, power_up.position) < 1.0:
                        robot.apply_power_up(power_up)
                        power_up.active = False
                        
        # Check for objective completion
        self.check_objectives()

        for power_up in self.power_ups:

    def distance(self, pos1: Position, pos2: Position) -> float:
        """Calculate distance between two positions"""
        return ((pos1.x - pos2.x)**2 + (pos1.y - pos2.y)**2 + (pos1.z - pos2.z)**2)**0.5

        """Decrease the difficulty level of the arena"""
        self.difficulty = max(0.5, self.difficulty - 0.1)
        self._adjust_ai_behavior("decrease")

        """Adjust the AI behavior based on the difficulty change"""
        for robot in self.robots:

                robot.update(self.current_time, self)
                robot.update_position(time_delta)

    def __init__(self, weapon_type):
        self.weapon_type = weapon_type
        self.damage = self._set_damage()
        self.range = self._set_range()
        self.cooldown = self._set_cooldown()

    def _set_damage(self):

            WeaponType.SHOCK_WAVE: 40,
            WeaponType.FLAME_THROWER: 15,

        }
        return damage[self.weapon_type]

    def _set_range(self):
        """Set range based on weapon type"""
        range_ = {
            WeaponType.LASER_RIFLE: 10,
            WeaponType.PLASMA_CANNON: 15,
            WeaponType.SHOCK_WAVE: 8,
            WeaponType.FLAME_THROWER: 5,
            WeaponType.ICE_BLADE: 1
        }
        return range_[self.weapon_type]

    def _set_cooldown(self):
        """Set cooldown time based on weapon type"""
        cooldown = {
            WeaponType.LASER_RIFLE: 0.5,
            WeaponType.PLASMA_CANNON: 1.2,
            WeaponType.SHOCK_WAVE: 2.0,
            WeaponType.FLAME_THROWER: 0.3,
            WeaponType.ICE_BLADE: 0.7
        }
        return cooldown[self.weapon_type]

# Class for AI-controlled robots in CyberArena
class Robot(Entity):
    def __init__(self, name, x, y, team, weapon_type):
        super().__init__(name, x, y)
        self.team = team  # Team affiliation (team1 or team2)
        self.weapon = Weapon(weapon_type)
        self.last_shot_time = 0
        self.score = 0
        self.role = self._assign_role()
        self.skills = {
            "targeting": random.uniform(0.7, 1.0),  # Accuracy of targeting
            "movement": random.uniform(0.6, 0.9),   # Movement agility
            "tactical": random.uniform(0.5, 0.8)    # Tactical decision making
        }

    def _assign_role(self):
        """Assign a dynamic role to the robot based on skill set"""
        if self.skills["tactical"] > 0.75:
            return "Commander"
        elif self.skills["targeting"] > 0.85:
            return "Sniper"
        elif self.skills["movement"] > 0.8:
            return "Scout"
        else:
            return "Assaulter"

    def attack(self, target):
        """Attempt to attack a target entity"""
        current_time = time.time()
        distance = self._calculate_distance(target)
        
        # Check if weapon is ready and target is in range
        if current_time - self.last_shot_time >= self.weapon.cooldown and distance <= self.weapon.range:
            # Calculate hit probability based on distance and targeting skill
            hit_probability = max(0.1, 1 - (distance / self.weapon.range)) * self.skills["targeting"]
            
            if random.random() < hit_probability:
                target.take_damage(self.weapon.damage)
                self.last_shot_time = current_time
                return True
        return False

    def _calculate_distance(self, other):
        """Calculate Euclidean distance to another entity"""
        return ((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2)**0.5

# solution.py
import time
import json
import uuid
from collections import deque
from enum import Enum
import threading

# Enums for Task Status and Agent Availability
class TaskStatus(Enum):
    PENDING = "Pending"
    IN_PROGRESS = "In Progress"
    COMPLETED = "Completed"
    FAILED = "Failed"
    CANCELLED = "Cancelled"

class AgentAvailability(Enum):
    AVAILABLE = "Available"
    BUSY = "Busy"
    OFFLINE = "Offline"

# Task class to represent individual tasks
class Task:
    def __init__(self, name, description, priority, required_resources):
        self.task_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.name = name
        self.description = description
        self.priority = priority  # Integer, higher is more important
        self.required_resources = required_resources  # List of required resources
        self.status = TaskStatus.PENDING
        self.assigned_agent = None
        self.start_time = None
        self.end_time = None
        self.estimated_time = None
        self.notes = []

    def assign_agent(self, agent):
        if self.status == TaskStatus.PENDING and agent.availability == AgentAvailability.AVAILABLE:
            agent.mark_busy()
            self.assigned_agent = agent
            self.status = TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS
            self.start_time = time.time()
            return True
        return False

    def complete(self):
        self.status = TaskStatus.COMPLETED
        self.end_time = time.time()

    def fail(self):
        self.status = TaskStatus.FAILED
        self.end_time = time.time()

    def cancel(self):
        self.status = TaskStatus.CANCELLED
        self.end_time = time.time()

    def add_note(self, note):
        self.notes.append(note)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            "task_id": self.task_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "description": self.description,
            "priority": self.priority,
            "required_resources": self.required_resources,
            "status": self.status.value,
            "assigned_agent": self.assigned_agent.agent_id if self.assigned_agent else None,
            "start_time": self.start_time,
            "end_time": self.end_time,
            "estimated_time": self.estimated_time,
            "notes": self.notes
        }

# Agent class representing a worker or participant in the task system
class Agent:
    def __init__(self, name, agent_id=None):
        self.name = name
        self.agent_id = agent_id if agent_id else str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.availability = AgentAvailability.AVAILABLE
        self.current_task = None
        self.task_history = []
        self.chat_messages = []

    def mark_busy(self):
        self.availability = AgentAvailability.BUSY

    def mark_available(self):
        self.availability = AgentAvailability.AVAILABLE

    def mark_offline(self):
        self.availability = AgentAvailability.OFFLINE

    def receive_message(self, message, sender):
        self.chat_messages.append({"sender": sender.name, "message": message, "timestamp": time.time()})

    def add_to_history(self, task):
        self.task_history.append(task)

    def is_available_for_task(self, task):
        return self.availability == AgentAvailability.AVAILABLE and all(resource in self.capabilities for resource in task.required_resources)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
            "availability": self.availability.value,
            "current_task": self.current_task.task_id if self.current_task else None,
            "task_history": [t.task_id for t in self.task_history]
        }

# Task Scheduler class to manage tasks and agents
class MultiAgentTaskScheduler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tasks = []
        self.agents = []
        self.task_history = []
        self.task_queue = deque()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

    def add_task(self, name, description, priority, required_resources):
        task = Task(name, description, priority, required_resources)
        self.tasks.append(task)
        self._reorganize_tasks()
        return task

    def add_agent(self, name):
        agent = Agent(name)
        self.agents.append(agent)
        return agent

    def _reorganize_tasks(self):
        # Sort tasks by priority and estimated time
        self.task_queue = deque(sorted(self.tasks, key=lambda t: (-t.priority, t.estimated_time if t.estimated_time else float('inf'))))

    def _assign_tasks(self):
        for task in list(self.task_queue):
            for agent in self.agents:
                if agent.availability == AgentAvailability.AVAILABLE and all(resource in agent.capabilities for resource in task.required_resources):
                    if task.assign_agent(agent):
                        agent.current_task = task
                        agent.mark_busy()
                        self._reorganize_tasks()
                        task.add_note(f"Assigned to {agent.name}")
                        self._log_task(task)
                        break

    def _log_task(self, task):
        self.task_history.append({
            "task_id": task.task_id,
            "name": task.name,
            "assigned_to": task.assigned_agent.name if task.assigned_agent else None,
            "start_time": task.start_time,
            "end_time": task.end_time,
            "status": task.status.value,
            "notes": task.notes
        })

    def _check_for_changes(self):
        while True:
            with self.lock:
                self._assign_tasks()
                for task in self.tasks:
                    # Simulate task progress
                    if task.status == TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS:
                        time.sleep(2)  # Simulate time passing
                        if random.random() < 0.2:
                            task.fail()
                            task.add_note(f"Task {task.name} failed due to simulated error.")
                        else:
                            task.complete()
                            task.add_note(f"Task {task.name} completed successfully.")
                            task.assigned_agent.mark_available()
                            task.assigned_agent.add_to_history(task)

                # Reassign if agents become available
                for agent in self.agents:
                    if agent.availability == AgentAvailability.AVAILABLE and self.task_queue:
                        self._assign_tasks()

            time.sleep(5)  # Check every 5 seconds for changes

    def start_scheduler(self):
        monitor_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._check_for_changes)
        monitor_thread.daemon = True
        monitor_thread.start()

    def get_task_progress(self):
        return [t.to_dict() for t in self.tasks]

    def get_agent_status(self):
        return [a.to_dict() for a in self.agents]

    def get_task_history(self):
        return self.task_history

    def send_message(self, sender, receiver, message):
        receiver.receive_message(message, sender)

# Example usage

    scheduler = MultiAgentTaskScheduler()

    # Create agents

        self.assigned_agents = []

        if agent.status == AgentStatus.BUSY:

        elif new_status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED or new_status == TaskStatus.FAILED or new_status == TaskStatus.CANCELED:

    def assign_task(self, task):
        self.assigned_tasks.append(task)
        self.status = AgentStatus.BUSY

        self.assigned_tasks.remove(task)
        self.status = AgentStatus.IDLE

        recipient.chat_history.append(f'{self.name}: {message} (from {self.name})')

# Task Scheduler class
class TaskScheduler:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tasks = []
        self.agents = []
        self.task_history = []
        self.next_task_id = 1

    def add_task(self, name, description, priority, required_resources):
        task = Task(self.next_task_id, name, description, priority, required_resources)
        self.tasks.append(task)
        self.next_task_id += 1
        return task

    def add_agent(self, name):
        agent = Agent(len(self.agents)+1, name)
        self.agents.append(agent)
        return agent

    def reassign_tasks(self):
        # Reassign tasks based on agent availability
        for task in self.tasks:
            if task.status == TaskStatus.PENDING:
                for agent in self.agents:
                    if agent.status == AgentStatus.IDLE and task.assign_agent(agent):
                        break

        for task in self.tasks:

# Base class for all entities in CyberArena
class Entity:
    def __init__(self, name, x, y):
        self.name = name
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.health = 100
        self.is_alive = True

    def move(self, dx, dy):
        """Update position with given delta values"""
        self.x += dx
        self.y += dy

    def take_damage(self, amount):
        """Reduce health by specified amount"""
        self.health -= amount
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.die()

    def die(self):
        """Handle entity death"""
        self.is_alive = False

    def update(self):
        """Update entity state (implemented by subclasses)"""
        pass

# Different types of weapons available in CyberArena
class WeaponType(Enum):
    LASER_RIFLE = "Laser Rifle"
    PLASMA_CANNON = "Plasma Cannon"
    SHOCK_WAVE = "Shock Wave"
    FLAME_THROWER = "Flame Thrower"
    ICE_BLADE = "Ice Blade"

# Class for weapons that robots can use
class Weapon:
    def __init__(self, weapon_type):
        self.weapon_type = weapon_type
        self.damage = self._set_damage()
        self.range = self._set_range()
        self.cooldown = self._set_cooldown()

    def _set_damage(self):
        """Set damage based on weapon type"""
        damage = {
            WeaponType.LASER_RIFLE: 20,
            WeaponType.PLASMA_CANNON: 35,
            WeaponType.SHOCK_WAVE: 40,
            WeaponType.FLAME_THROWER: 15,
            WeaponType.ICE_BLADE: 25
        }
        return damage[self.weapon_type]

    def _set_range(self):
        """Set range based on weapon type"""
        range_ = {
            WeaponType.LASER_RIFLE: 10,
            WeaponType.PLASMA_CANNON: 15,
            WeaponType.SHOCK_WAVE: 8,
            WeaponType.FLAME_THROWER: 5,
            WeaponType.ICE_BLADE: 1
        }
        return range_[self.weapon_type]

    def _set_cooldown(self):
        """Set cooldown time based on weapon type"""
        cooldown = {
            WeaponType.LASER_RIFLE: 0.5,
            WeaponType.PLASMA_CANNON: 1.2,
            WeaponType.SHOCK_WAVE: 2.0,
            WeaponType.FLAME_THROWER: 0.3,
            WeaponType.ICE_BLADE: 0.7
        }
        return cooldown[self.weapon_type]

# Class for AI-controlled robots in CyberArena
class Robot(Entity):
    def __init__(self, name, x, y, team, weapon_type):
        super().__init__(name, x, y)
        self.team = team  # Team affiliation (team1 or team2)
        self.weapon = Weapon(weapon_type)
        self.last_shot_time = 0
        self.score = 0
        self.role = self._assign_role()
        self.skills = {
            "targeting": random.uniform(0.7, 1.0),  # Accuracy of targeting
            "movement": random.uniform(0.6, 0.9),   # Movement agility
            "tactical": random.uniform(0.5, 0.8)    # Tactical decision making
        }

    def _assign_role(self):
        """Assign a dynamic role to the robot based on skill set"""
        if self.skills["tactical"] > 0.75:
            return "Commander"
        elif self.skills["targeting"] > 0.85:
            return "Sniper"
        elif self.skills["movement"] > 0.8:
            return "Scout"
        else:
            return "Assaulter"

    def attack(self, target):
        """Attempt to attack a target entity"""
        current_time = time.time()
        distance = self._calculate_distance(target)
        
        # Check if weapon is ready and target is in range
        if current_time - self.last_shot_time >= self.weapon.cooldown and distance <= self.weapon.range:
            # Calculate hit probability based on distance and targeting skill
            hit_probability = max(0.1, 1 - (distance / self.weapon.range)) * self.skills["targeting"]
            
            if random.random() < hit_probability:
                target.take_damage(self.weapon.damage)
                self.last_shot_time = current_time
                return True
        return False

    def _calculate_distance(self, other):
        """Calculate Euclidean distance to another entity"""
        return ((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2)**0.5

    def update(self):
        """Update robot state (movement, targeting, etc.)"""
        # Basic movement pattern for demonstration
        if random.random() < 0.1:
            self.move(random.uniform(-1, 1), random.uniform(-1, 1))
        
        # Update skills based on experience (learning)
        self._learn_from_experience()

    def _learn_from_experience(self):
        """Improve skills based on recent performance"""
        # Simple learning mechanism for demonstration
        if random.random() < 0.05:  # 5% chance to improve a skill
            skill_to_improve = random.choice(list(self.skills.keys()))
            self.skills[skill_to_improve] = min(1.0, self.skills[skill_to_improve] + random.uniform(0.01, 0.05))

        self.name = name
        self.description = description
        self.deadline = deadline
        self.dependencies = dependencies or []
        self.status = TaskStatus.PENDING
        self.assignee: Optional[str] = None
        self.completion_time: Optional[str] = None
        self.history: List[Dict] = []

    def update_status(self, new_status: TaskStatus, user: str):
        now = datetime.now().isoformat()
        self.status = new_status
        self.history.append({
            "timestamp": now,
            "user": user,
            "action": f"Task status updated to {new_status.value}",
        })
        if new_status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED:
            self.completion_time = now

    def assign(self, user: str):
        if self.status == TaskStatus.PENDING:
            self.assignee = user
            self.history.append({
                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                "user": user,
                "action": "Task assigned to user"
            })

        self.username = username
        self.role = role

        self.name = name
        self.tasks: Dict[str, Task] = {}
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}

        if user.role != UserRole.PROJECT_MANAGER:
            raise PermissionError("Only Project Managers can add tasks.")
        self.tasks[task.task_id] = task

    def assign_task(self, task_id: str, user: User):
        if user.role not in [UserRole.PROJECT_MANAGER, UserRole.TEAM_LEAD]:
            raise PermissionError("Only Project Managers or Team Leads can assign tasks.")
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if task:
            task.assign(user.username)

    def get_task_status(self, task_id: str) -> Dict:
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if not task:
            return {"error": "Task not found"}
        return {

            "name": task.name,
            "description": task.description,
            "deadline": task.deadline,
            "status": task.status.value,
            "assignee": task.assignee,
            "dependencies": task.dependencies,
            "history": task.history,

        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if not task:

        for dep_id in task.dependencies:
            dep_task = self.tasks.get(dep_id)
            if not dep_task or dep_task.status != TaskStatus.COMPLETED:

        return task.status == TaskStatus.PENDING

    def update_task_status(self, task_id: str, new_status: TaskStatus, user: User):
        if user.role not in [UserRole.PROJECT_MANAGER, UserRole.TEAM_MEMBER]:
            raise PermissionError("Only Project Managers or Team Members can update task status.")
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if not task:

        if user.role == UserRole.TEAM_MEMBER and task.assignee != user.username:

            "completed_tasks": [],
            "delayed_tasks": [],

            dashboard[current_status.lower() + "_tasks"].append({

                "status": task.status.value,
                "assignee": task.assignee,

                    "name": task.name,
                    "deadline": task.deadline,
                })

import json

from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Set

# --- Task Creation and Management Module ---
@dataclass
class Task:
    task_id: int
    description: str
    due_date: datetime
    priority: int  # 1 = High, 2 = Medium, 3 = Low
    assigned_to: List[str]
    status: str = "Pending"
    dependencies: List[int] = None

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.dependencies = self.dependencies or []

    def complete_task(self):
        self.status = "Completed"
        print(f"✅ Task {self.task_id} marked as completed.")


class TaskManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tasks: Dict[int, Task] = {}
        self.next_task_id: int = 1

    def create_task(self, description: str, due_date: datetime, priority: int, assigned_to: List[str], dependencies: List[int] = None):
        task = Task(
            task_id=self.next_task_id,
            description=description,
            due_date=due_date,
            priority=priority,
            assigned_to=assigned_to,
            dependencies=dependencies or []
        )
        self.tasks[self.next_task_id] = task
        self.next_task_id += 1
        print(f"➕ Task {task.task_id} created.")
        return task.task_id

    def get_task(self, task_id: int) -> Optional[Task]:
        return self.tasks.get(task_id)

    def update_task(self, task_id: int, **kwargs):
        task = self.get_task(task_id)
        if task:
            for key, value in kwargs.items():
                if hasattr(task, key):
                    setattr(task, key, value)
            print(f"📝 Task {task_id} updated with new details.")
        else:
            print(f"❌ Task {task_id} not found.")

    def delete_task(self, task_id: int):
        if task_id in self.tasks:
            del self.tasks[task_id]
            print(f"🗑️ Task {task_id} deleted.")
        else:
            print(f"❌ Task {task_id} not found.")

    def list_tasks(self):
        for task_id, task in self.tasks.items():
            print(f"Task {task_id}: {task.description}, Due: {task.due_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}, Priority: {task.priority}, Assigned to: {task.assigned_to}, Status: {task.status}")


# --- Task Scheduling Module ---
class TaskScheduler:
    def __init__(self, task_manager: TaskManager):
        self.task_manager = task_manager
        self.schedule: Dict[datetime, List[int]] = {}

    def schedule_tasks(self):
        self.schedule.clear()
        current_time = datetime.now()

        for task_id, task in self.task_manager.tasks.items():
            if task.status == "Pending":
                self._add_task_to_schedule(task)

    def _add_task_to_schedule(self, task: Task):
        for dep_id in task.dependencies:
            dep_task = self.task_manager.get_task(dep_id)
            if dep_task and dep_task.status == "Pending":
                print(f"⚠️ Task {task.task_id} cannot be scheduled until dependency {dep_id} is completed.")
                return
        self.schedule.setdefault(task.due_date, []).append(task.task_id)
        print(f"📅 Task {task.task_id} scheduled for due date: {task.due_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")

    def update_schedule_on_task_completion(self, task_id: int):
        task = self.task_manager.get_task(task_id)
        if task and task.status == "Completed":
            for other_task_id, other_task in self.task_manager.tasks.items():
                if task_id in other_task.dependencies:
                    self._add_task_to_schedule(other_task)


# --- Resource Allocation Module ---
class Resource:
    def __init__(self, resource_id: str, name: str, capacity: int):
        self.resource_id = resource_id
        self.name = name
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.allocated = 0

    def allocate(self, amount: int):
        if self.allocated + amount <= self.capacity:
            self.allocated += amount
            print(f"➕ Allocated {amount} units of {self.name}.")
        else:
            print(f"⚠️ Cannot allocate {amount} units of {self.name}. Over-allocated.")


class ResourceManager:
    def __init__(self):

    def add_resource(self, resource_id: str, name: str, capacity: int):
        self.resources[resource_id] = Resource(resource_id, name, capacity)
        print(f"➕ Resource {resource_id}: {name} (Capacity: {capacity}) added.")

    def get_resource(self, resource_id: str) -> Optional[Resource]:
        return self.resources.get(resource_id)

    def allocate_resource_to_task(self, task_id: int, resource_id: str, amount: int):
        resource = self.get_resource(resource_id)
        if resource:
            resource.allocate(amount)
            print(f"➕ Task {task_id} allocated {amount} units of {resource.name}.")
        else:
            print(f"❌ Resource {resource_id} not found.")


# --- Real-Time Updates and Notifications Module ---

class RouteMode(Enum):
    FASTEST = "Fastest"

    MOST_ECO_FRIENDLY = "Most Eco-Friendly"


class Position:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def move(self, direction, distance):
        dx, dy = direction.value
        self.x += dx * distance
        self.y += dy * distance

    def distance_to(self, other):
        return math.hypot(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"Position({self.x}, {self.y})"


class TrafficCondition:
    def __init__(self, road_id, congestion_level, accident_status, closure_status):
        self.road_id = road_id
        self.congestion_level = congestion_level  # 0-100 scale

        closure_status = random.choice([True, False])

            )
        )
        time.sleep(1)

        self.route_mode = route_mode

        self.cost = 0
        self.eco_impact = 0

    def calculate_metrics(self):
        total_time = 0
        total_cost = 0
        total_impact = 0
        
        for i in range(len(self.path) - 1):
            dist = self.path[i].distance_to(self.path[i+1])
            avg_speed = 20  # km/h
            time = dist / avg_speed
            total_time += time
            
            # Simulate cost and eco impact based on distance and mode
            cost_per_km = 0.5 if self.mode == RouteMode.MOST_ECO_FRIENDLY else 1.0
            total_cost += dist * cost_per_km
            
            eco_per_km = 0.1 if self.mode == RouteMode.MOST_ECO_FRIENDLY else 0.3
            total_impact += dist * eco_per_km

        self.estimated_time = total_time

def calculate_route(start, destination, route_mode):
    # Use a simple A* algorithm for demonstration
    open_set = []
    heapq.heuristicq((0, start))
    came_from = {}
    g_score = {start: 0}
    f_score = {start: heuristic(start, destination)}
    
    while open_set:
        current = heapq.heappop(open_set)[1]
        
        if current == destination:
            path = reconstruct_path(came_from, current)
            return Route(user=None, path=path, mode=route_mode)
        
        for neighbor in get_neighbors(current):
            tentative_g = g_score[current] + 1
            if tentative_g < g_score.get(neighbor, float('inf')):
                came_from[neighbor] = current
                g_score[neighbor] = tentative_g
                f_score[neighbor] = tentative_g + heuristic(neighbor, destination)
                heapq.heappush(open_set, (f_score[neighbor], neighbor))

import random

class WeaponType(Enum):
    LASER = 0

class PowerUpType(Enum):
    SPEED_BOOST = 0

    TELEPORT = 3

class Team(Enum):
    ALPHA = 0

class ObjectiveType(Enum):
    CAPTURE_FLAG = 0
