class Position:
    """Represents a 2D position on the battlefield"""
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def distance_to(self, other_position):
        """Calculate Euclidean distance to another position"""
        return np.sqrt((self.x - other_position.x)**2 + (self.y - other_position.y)**2)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"({self.x}, {self.y})"

class Robot:
    """Represents an AI-controlled robot in the CyberArena battle"""
    def __init__(self, robot_id, team, position):
        self.robot_id = robot_id
        self.team = team
        self.position = position
        self.health = 100
        self.speed = 5
        self.weapon = None
        self.power_ups = []
        self.last_known_opponent_position = None
        self.experience = 0
        self.role = None  # Will be assigned based on team strategy
        self.movement_history = []

    def assign_weapon(self, weapon_type):
        """Assign a specific weapon to the robot"""
        self.weapon = Weapon(weapon_type, self)

    def assign_power_up(self, power_up_type):
        """Assign a power-up to the robot"""
        self.power_ups.append(PowerUp(power_up_type, self))

    def move(self, direction, distance):
        """Move the robot in a given direction with specified distance"""
        if direction == Direction.UP:
            self.position.y += distance
        elif direction == Direction.RIGHT:
            self.position.x += distance
        elif direction == Direction.DOWN:
            self.position.y -= distance
        elif direction == Direction.LEFT:
            self.position.x -= distance

        self.movement_history.append((self.position.x, self.position.y))

    def detect_opponent(self, arena):
        """Detect nearby opponents in the arena"""
        for robot in arena.robots:
            if robot.team != self.team and self.position.distance_to(robot.position) < 10:
                self.last_known_opponent_position = robot.position
                return robot
        return None

    def attack(self, target):
        """Attack a target robot with the current weapon"""
        if self.weapon is not None and self.weapon.is_ready():
            damage = self.weapon.attack(target)

class Weapon:
    """Base class for different types of weapons"""
    def __init__(self, weapon_type, robot):
        self.weapon_type = weapon_type
        self.robot = robot
        self.cooldown = self.get_base_cooldown()
        self.last_used = 0

    def get_base_cooldown(self):
        """Return base cooldown time based on weapon type"""
        cooldowns = {
            WeaponType.LASER: 1.0,
            WeaponType.PLASMA: 2.5,
            WeaponType.SABER: 0.5,
            WeaponType.MISSILE: 4.0,
            WeaponType.SHIELD: 3.0
        }
        return cooldowns[self.weapon_type]

    def is_ready(self):
        """Check if weapon is ready to use"""
        return time.time() - self.last_used >= self.cooldown

    def attack(self, target):
        """Base attack method - to be implemented by subclasses"""
        if self.is_ready():

class PowerUp:
    """Represents a power-up that can be collected by robots"""

        self.duration = self.get_base_duration()

        self.start_time = time.time()

    def get_base_duration(self):
        """Return base duration for each power-up type"""
        durations = {

            PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST: 15,
            PowerUpType.SHIELD: 20,
            PowerUpType.TELEPORT: 1,
            PowerUpType.REPAIR: 5
        }
        return durations[self.power_up_type]

    def is_active(self):
        """Check if power-up is still active"""

    def activate(self):
        """Activate the power-up and return its effect"""
        effect = None
        
        if self.power_up_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:

    def update(self):

class CyberArena:
    """Main class representing the CyberArena battle simulation"""
    def __init__(self, width=100, height=100):

        self.objectives.append(BaseDefenseObjective(Team.BETA, Position(90, 90)))

        self.objectives.append(PayloadEscortObjective(Team.BETA, Position(70, 30), Position(30, 70)))

    def start_battle(self):
        """Start the battle simulation in real-time"""
        battle_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._battle_loop)
        battle_thread.start()

    def _battle_loop(self):
        """Main battle loop that runs in a separate thread"""
        tick = 0
        while self.running and tick < 1000:  # Run for 1000 ticks (simulated 10 minutes)
            self.update_environment()
            self.update_robots()
            self.update_objectives()
            self.check_for_battle_end()
            self.update_scoreboard()
            
            # Print status every 50 ticks

                self.print_status()
                
            time.sleep(0.1)  # Simulate real-time gameplay (100ms tick rate)
            tick += 1

        """Update the environment (weather, power-ups, hazards)"""
        self.environment.update_weather()

        for robot in self.robots:

            if self.environment.check_power_up_collision(robot):

            if self.environment.check_hazard_collision(robot):

            direction = random.choice(list(Direction))

            robot.move(direction, distance)
            
            # Try to detect and attack opponents
            opponent = robot.detect_opponent(self)
            if opponent is not None:
                damage = robot.attack(opponent)
                if damage > 0:
                    # Calculate battle effectiveness for learning
                    effectiveness = damage / (robot.weapon.calculate_damage() + 1)
                    battle_outcome = BattleOutcome(success=True, effectiveness=effectiveness,

class Position:
    """Represents a 2D position on the battlefield"""
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def distance_to(self, other_position):
        """Calculate Euclidean distance to another position"""
        return np.sqrt((self.x - other_position.x)**2 + (self.y - other_position.y)**2)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"({self.x}, {self.y})"

class Robot:
    """Represents an AI-controlled robot in the CyberArena battle"""
    def __init__(self, robot_id, team, position):
        self.robot_id = robot_id
        self.team = team
        self.position = position
        self.health = 100
        self.speed = 5
        self.weapon = None
        self.power_ups = []
        self.last_known_opponent_position = None
        self.experience = 0
        self.role = None  # Will be assigned based on team strategy
        self.movement_history = []

    def assign_weapon(self, weapon_type):
        """Assign a specific weapon to the robot"""
        self.weapon = Weapon(weapon_type, self)

    def assign_power_up(self, power_up_type):
        """Assign a power-up to the robot"""
        self.power_ups.append(PowerUp(power_up_type, self))

    def move(self, direction, distance):
        """Move the robot in a given direction with specified distance"""
        if direction == Direction.UP:
            self.position.y += distance
        elif direction == Direction.RIGHT:
            self.position.x += distance
        elif direction == Direction.DOWN:
            self.position.y -= distance
        elif direction == Direction.LEFT:
            self.position.x -= distance

        self.movement_history.append((self.position.x, self.position.y))

    def detect_opponent(self, arena):
        """Detect nearby opponents in the arena"""
        for robot in arena.robots:
            if robot.team != self.team and self.position.distance_to(robot.position) < 10:
                self.last_known_opponent_position = robot.position
                return robot
        return None

    def attack(self, target):
        """Attack a target robot with the current weapon"""
        if self.weapon is not None and self.weapon.is_ready():
            damage = self.weapon.attack(target)
            print(f"Robot {self.robot_id} attacked Robot {target.robot_id} for {damage} damage!")
            return damage
        return 0

    def use_power_up(self, power_up_type):
        """Use a specific power-up"""
        for power_up in self.power_ups:
            if power_up.power_up_type == power_up_type and power_up.is_active():
                effect = power_up.activate()
                print(f"Robot {self.robot_id} used power-up {power_up_type.name}: {effect}")
                return effect
        return None

    def learn_from_battle(self, battle_outcome):
        """Update robot's strategy based on battle outcome"""
        self.experience += battle_outcome.effectiveness
        if battle_outcome.success:
            self.role = battle_outcome.new_role
            if random.random() < 0.3:  # 30% chance to change weapon
                self.assign_weapon(random.choice(list(WeaponType)))

    def get_position(self):
        """Return current position"""
        return self.position

class Weapon:
    """Base class for different types of weapons"""
    def __init__(self, weapon_type, robot):
        self.weapon_type = weapon_type
        self.robot = robot
        self.cooldown = self.get_base_cooldown()
        self.last_used = 0

    def get_base_cooldown(self):
        """Return base cooldown time based on weapon type"""
        cooldowns = {
            WeaponType.LASER: 1.0,
            WeaponType.PLASMA: 2.5,
            WeaponType.SABER: 0.5,
            WeaponType.MISSILE: 4.0,
            WeaponType.SHIELD: 3.0
        }
        return cooldowns[self.weapon_type]

    def is_ready(self):
        """Check if weapon is ready to use"""
        return time.time() - self.last_used >= self.cooldown

    def attack(self, target):
        """Base attack method - to be implemented by subclasses"""
        if self.is_ready():
            self.last_used = time.time()
            damage = self.calculate_damage()
            target.health -= damage
            return damage
        return 0

    def calculate_damage(self):
        """Calculate base damage based on weapon type"""
        damage = {
            WeaponType.LASER: random.randint(10, 20),
            WeaponType.PLASMA: random.randint(15, 30),
            WeaponType.SABER: random.randint(20, 35),
            WeaponType.MISSILE: random.randint(25, 40),
            WeaponType.SHIELD: 0  # Shield doesn't deal damage
        }
        return damage[self.weapon_type]

class PowerUp:
    """Represents a power-up that can be collected by robots"""
    def __init__(self, power_up_type, robot):
        self.power_up_type = power_up_type
        self.robot = robot
        self.duration = self.get_base_duration()
        self.remaining_time = self.duration
        self.start_time = time.time()

    def get_base_duration(self):
        """Return base duration for each power-up type"""
        durations = {
            PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST: 10,
            PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST: 15,
            PowerUpType.SHIELD: 20,
            PowerUpType.TELEPORT: 1,
            PowerUpType.REPAIR: 5
        }
        return durations[self.power_up_type]

    def is_active(self):
        """Check if power-up is still active"""
        return self.remaining_time > 0

    def activate(self):
        """Activate the power-up and return its effect"""
        effect = None
        
        if self.power_up_type == PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST:
            self.robot.speed *= 1.5
            effect = f"Speed increased by 50% for {self.duration} seconds"
        elif self.power_up_type == PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST:
            self.robot.weapon.cooldown *= 0.75
            effect = f"Weapon cooldown reduced by 25% for {self.duration} seconds"
        elif self.power_up_type == PowerUpType.SHIELD:
            self.robot.health += 50
            effect = f"Health increased by 50 for {self.duration} seconds"
        elif self.power_up_type == PowerUpType.TELEPORT:
            new_position = Position(random.randint(0, 100), random.randint(0, 100))
            self.robot.position = new_position
            effect = f"Teleported to random location"
        elif self.power_up_type == PowerUpType.REPAIR:
            self.robot.health = min(100, self.robot.health + 30)
            effect = f"Health restored by 30 points"

        return effect

    def update(self):
        """Update power-up duration"""
        if self.is_active():
            self.remaining_time = max(0, self.duration - (time.time() - self.start_time))

class Environment:
    """Represents the battlefield environment with hazards and power-ups"""
    def __init__(self, width, height):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.power_ups = []
        self.hazards = []
        self.weather = "clear"
        self.generate_random_elements()

    def generate_random_elements(self):
        """Generate random power-ups and hazards in the environment"""
        for _ in range(5):  # Create 5 power-ups
            x = random.randint(0, self.width)
            y = random.randint(0, self.height)
            power_up_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
            self.power_ups.append(Position(x, y))
        
        for _ in range(3):  # Create 3 hazards
            x = random.randint(0, self.width)
            y = random.randint(0, self.height)
            self.hazards.append(Position(x, y))

    def check_power_up_collision(self, robot):
        """Check if robot collides with a power-up"""
        for power_up_pos in self.power_ups:
            if robot.position.distance_to(power_up_pos) < 2:
                power_up_type = random.choice(list(PowerUpType))
                robot.assign_power_up(power_up_type)
                self.power_ups.remove(power_up_pos)
                return True
        return False

    def check_hazard_collision(self, robot):
        """Check if robot collides with a hazard"""
        for hazard_pos in self.hazards:
            if robot.position.distance_to(hazard_pos) < 3:
                robot.health -= 15
                print(f"Robot {robot.robot_id} hit a hazard! Health reduced by 15")
                return True
        return False

    def update_weather(self):
        """Randomly change the weather to affect gameplay"""

class CyberArena:
    """Main class representing the CyberArena battle simulation"""
    def __init__(self, width=100, height=100):
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.robots = []
        self.environment = Environment(width, height)
        self.objectives = []
        self.scoreboard = defaultdict(int)
        self.running = True
        
        # Initialize game with 8 robots (2 teams x 4 robots)
        for i in range(4):
            robot1 = Robot(i * 2, Team.ALPHA, Position(random.randint(0, self.width), random.randint(0, self.height)))
            robot2 = Robot(i * 2 + 1, Team.BETA, Position(random.randint(0, self.width), random.randint(0, self.height)))
            robot1.assign_weapon(WeaponType.LASER)
            robot2.assign_weapon(WeaponType.PLASMA)
            self.robots.append(robot1)
            self.robots.append(robot2)
        
        # Create objectives
        self.create_objectives()

    def create_objectives(self):
        """Initialize different types of objectives for the game"""
        # Flag capture objective
        self.objectives.append(FlagCaptureObjective(Team.ALPHA, Position(20, 20)))
        self.objectives.append(FlagCaptureObjective(Team.BETA, Position(80, 80)))
        
        # Base defense objective
        self.objectives.append(BaseDefenseObjective(Team.ALPHA, Position(10, 10)))
        self.objectives.append(BaseDefenseObjective(Team.BETA, Position(90, 90)))
        
        # Payload escort objective
        self.objectives.append(PayloadEscortObjective(Team.ALPHA, Position(30, 30), Position(70, 70)))
        self.objectives.append(PayloadEscortObjective(Team.BETA, Position(70, 30), Position(30, 70)))

    def start_battle(self):
        """Start the battle simulation in real-time"""
        battle_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._battle_loop)
        battle_thread.start()

    def _battle_loop(self):
        """Main battle loop that runs in a separate thread"""
        tick = 0
        while self.running and tick < 1000:  # Run for 1000 ticks (simulated 10 minutes)
            self.update_environment()
            self.update_robots()
            self.update_objectives()
            self.check_for_battle_end()
            self.update_scoreboard()
            
            # Print status every 50 ticks
            if tick % 50 == 0:
                self.print_status()
                
            time.sleep(0.1)  # Simulate real-time gameplay (100ms tick rate)
            tick += 1

    def update_environment(self):
        """Update the environment (weather, power-ups, hazards)"""
        self.environment.update_weather()
        
        # Randomly generate new power-ups
        if random.random() < 0.05:  # 5% chance per tick
            x = random.randint(0, self.width)
            y = random.randint(0, self.height)
            self.environment.power_ups.append(Position(x, y))
        
        # Update power-up durations
        for robot in self.robots:
            for power_up in robot.power_ups:
                power_up.update()

    def update_robots(self):
        """Update robot positions and behaviors"""
        for robot in self.robots:
            # Check for power-up collisions
            if self.environment.check_power_up_collision(robot):
                print(f"Robot {robot.robot_id} collected a power-up!")
            
            # Check for hazard collisions
            if self.environment.check_hazard_collision(robot):
                print(f"Robot {robot.robot_id} got hit by a hazard!")
            
            # Basic AI behavior: move towards a random direction
            direction = random.choice(list(Direction))
            distance = robot.speed * random.uniform(0.5, 1.5)
            robot.move(direction, distance)
            
            # Try to detect and attack opponents
            opponent = robot.detect_opponent(self)
            if opponent is not None:
                damage = robot.attack(opponent)
                if damage > 0:
                    # Calculate battle effectiveness for learning
                    effectiveness = damage / (robot.weapon.calculate_damage() + 1)
                    battle_outcome = BattleOutcome(success=True, effectiveness=effectiveness, 
                                                  new_role=Team.LEADER if effectiveness > 0.8 else robot.role)
                    robot.learn_from_battle(battle_outcome)
                else:
                    robot.learn_from_battle(BattleOutcome(success=False, effectiveness=0.3))
            
            # Use power-up if available
            if random.random() < 0.1 and len(robot.power_ups) > 0:
                power_up_type = random.choice([pu.power_up_type for pu in robot.power_ups])
                robot.use_power_up(power_up_type)

    def update_objectives(self):
        """Update all objectives in the game"""
        for objective in self.objectives:
            objective.update(self)

    def check_for_battle_end(self):
        """Check if the battle should end based on objectives"""
        for objective in self.objectives:
            if objective.check_completion(self):
                self.running = False
                break

    def update_scoreboard(self):
        """Update the game scoreboard based on robot performance"""
        for robot in self.robots:
            # Score for survival
            self.scoreboard[robot.robot_id] += robot.health / 100 * 10
            
            # Score for damage dealt
            if hasattr(robot, 'damage_dealt'):
                self.scoreboard[robot.robot_id] += robot.damage_dealt / 10
                
            # Score for objectives completed
            for objective in self.objectives:
                if objective.check_completion(self) and robot.team == objective.team:
                    self.scoreboard[robot.robot_id] += 50

    def print_status(self):
        """Print current game status to console"""
        print(f"\n=== CyberArena Status ===")
        print(f"Weather: {self.environment.weather}")
        print(f"Active power-ups: {len(self.environment.power_ups)}")
        print(f"Active hazards: {len(self.environment.hazards)}")
        
        # Print robot status
        for robot in self.robots:
            print(f"\nRobot {robot.robot_id} ({robot.team.name}):")
            print(f"  Position: {robot.position}")
            print(f"  Health: {robot.health}")
            print(f"  Weapon: {robot.weapon.weapon_type.name if robot.weapon else 'None'}")
            print(f"  Power-ups: {[pu.power_up_type.name for pu in robot.power_ups]}")
            print(f"  Experience: {robot.experience}")
            print(f"  Role: {robot.role}")
        
        # Print objectives status
        print("\nObjectives:")
        for objective in self.objectives:
            print(f"  {objective.get_status()}")
        
        # Print scoreboard
        print("\nScoreboard:")
        for robot_id, score in self.scoreboard.items():
            print(f"  Robot {robot_id}: {score:.1f} points")

    def end_battle(self):
        """End the battle and print final results"""
        print("\n=== Battle Ended ===")
        print("Final Scoreboard:")
        for robot_id, score in self.scoreboard.items():
            print(f"Robot {robot_id}: {score:.1f} points")
        
        # Determine winner based on objectives
        for objective in self.objectives:
            if objective.check_completion(self):
                print(f"Winning objective: {objective.objective_type.name} completed by {objective.team.name} team!")
                break

def main():
    """Main function to run the CyberArena simulation"""
    print("=== CyberArena Battle Simulation ===")
    arena = CyberArena(width=100, height=100)
    arena.start_battle()

        return time.time() - self.last_used >= self.cooldown

Please write a software application called Travel_Collaborator that enables users to plan, share, and collaborate on travel itineraries. Travel_Collaborator is a web-based platform that allows users to create detailed travel plans, invite others to contribute, and manage the entire travel planning process collaboratively. # solution.py

# == ENUMS ==
from enum import Enum
from datetime import datetime
import uuid
from typing import List, Dict, Optional

# == ENUMS ==

class AccessLevel(Enum):
    VIEW_ONLY = "View Only"
    EDIT = "Edit"
    ADMIN = "Admin"

# == MODELS ==

class User:
    def __init__(self, user_id: str, name: str, email: str, password: str):
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.name = name
        self.email = email
        self.password = password  # In a real app, this should be hashed!
        self.profile = {"bio": "", "privacy": "public"}
        self.collaborations: List[Dict] = []

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            "user_id": self.user_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "email": self.email,
            "profile": self.profile,
            "collaborations": self.collaborations
        }

class Activity:
    def __init__(self, activity_id: str, name: str, description: str, 
                 start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime, location: str):
        self.activity_id = activity_id
        self.name = name
        self.description = description
        self.start_time = start_time
        self.end_time = end_time
        self.location = location
        self.comments: List[Dict] = []

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            "activity_id": self.activity_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "description": self.description,
            "start_time": self.start_time.isoformat(),
            "end_time": self.end_time.isoformat(),
            "location": self.location,
            "comments": self.comments
        }

class Itinerary:
    def __init__(self, itinerary_id: str, name: str, creator_id: str, members: List[str]):
        self.itinerary_id = itinerary_id
        self.name = name
        self.creator_id = creator_id
        self.members = {member_id: {"access": AccessLevel.EDIT} for member_id in [creator_id] + members}
        self.activities: List[Activity] = []
        self.comments = {}

    def add_activity(self, activity: Activity):
        self.activities.append(activity)

    def add_member(self, user_id: str, access: AccessLevel):
        self.members[user_id] = {"access": access}

    def to_dict(self):
        return {
            "itinerary_id": self.itinerary_id,
            "name": self.name,
            "creator_id": self.creator_id,
            "members": self.members,
            "activities": [a.to_dict() for a in self.activities]
        }

# == CORE SYSTEMS ==

class UserManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}

    def register_user(self, name: str, email: str, password: str) -> str:
        if email in [u.email for u in self.users.values()]:
            raise ValueError("Email already exists")
        user_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.users[user_id] = User(user_id, name, email, password)
        return user_id

    def get_user(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[User]:
        return self.users.get(user_id)

    def update_profile(self, user_id: str, bio: str, privacy: str):
        user = self.get_user(user_id)
        if user:
            user.profile["bio"] = bio
            user.profile["privacy"] = privacy

class ItineraryManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.itineraries: Dict[str, Itinerary] = {}

    def create_itinerary(self, name: str, creator_id: str) -> str:
        itinerary_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        self.itineraries[itinerary_id] = Itinerary(itinerary_id, name, creator_id, [])
        return itinerary_id

    def add_member_to_itinerary(self, itinerary_id: str, user_id: str, access: AccessLevel):
        itinerary = self.itineraries.get(itinerary_id)
        if itinerary:
            itinerary.add_member(user_id, access)

    def add_activity_to_itinerary(self, itinerary_id: str, activity: Activity):
        itinerary = self.itineraries.get(itinerary_id)
        if itinerary:
            itinerary.add_activity(activity)

    def get_itinerary(self, itinerary_id: str) -> Optional[Itinerary]:
        return self.itineraries.get(itinerary_id)

# == MAIN APPLICATION ==

def main():
    # Initialize managers
    user_manager = UserManager()
    itinerary_manager = ItineraryManager()

    # Sample users
    user1_id = user_manager.register_user("Alice", "alice@example.com", "password1")
    user2_id = user_manager.register_user("Bob", "bob@example.com", "password2")

    # Sample itineraries
    itin1_id = itinerary_manager.create_itinerary("Trip to Japan", user1_id)
    itinerary_manager.add_member_to_itinerary(itin1_id, user2_id, AccessLevel.EDIT)

    # Sample activity
    activity1 = Activity(
        str(uuid.uuid4()),
        "Visit Tokyo Tower",
        "A scenic tour of Tokyo Tower",
        datetime(2025, 5, 15, 10, 0),
        datetime(2025, 5, 15, 12, 0),
        "Tokyo, Japan"
    )
    itinerary_manager.add_activity_to_itinerary(itin1_id, activity1)

    # Output
    user1 = user_manager.get_user(user1_id)
    itin1 = itinerary_manager.get_itinerary(itin1_id)

    print("User Profile:")
    print(user1.to_dict())
    print("\nItinerary Details:")
    print(itin1.to_dict())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class Video:
    def __init__(self, video_id: str, file_path: str, duration: float):
        self.video_id = video_id
        self.file_path = file_path
        self.duration = duration
        self.timeline: List[Dict] = []
        self.version_history: List[Dict] = []
        self.current_version = 1

    def add_edit(self, user: User, edit: Dict):
        edit["user_id"] = user.user_id
        self.timeline.append(edit)

    def save_version(self, user: User, description: str = ""):
        version_data = {
            "version": self.current_version,
            "user_id": user.user_id,
            "description": description,
            "timeline": self.timeline.copy()
        }
        self.version_history.append(version_data)
        self.current_version += 1

    def revert_to_version(self, version_number: int):
        if 1 <= version_number < self.current_version:
            version = next((v for v in self.version_history if v["version"] == version_number), None)
            if version:
                self.timeline = version["timeline"]
                self.current_version = version_number + 1
                return True
        return False
